references.note: Approved disc, light, camera and matte miniature finish; do not copy its creature. Match this disc's own lightness EXACTLY -- do not darken it further.

Native shape (64x128 tall): a crouching red-brown muscular ogre with wild dark red hair, a snarling tusked mouth and a gold-gauntleted hand. Keep the brick-red skin, wild dark red hair, bare scarred chest and brown loincloth; the shipped superseded flat token's raised gold gauntlet with no weapon is the exact defect -- the NPC equips a greatmaul (ogre.lua:95) and the accepted standee holds a big two-handed maul.

The SUPERSEDED ogre mauler flat token for this same identity: crouched pose family, brick-red skin, wild dark red hair, bare scarred chest, brown loincloth, disc and camera are correct and must be kept, but its raised gold gauntlet/fist with no maul is the exact defect -- the NPC equips a greatmaul (game/modules/tome/data/general/npcs/ogre.lua:95) and the accepted standee holds a big two-handed maul. Replace only the gauntlet/fist with the two-handed maul; keep everything else.

prompt_fields.subject: An ogre mauler seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a huge hunched furious muscular human-shaped ogre with brick-red skin and lighter orange highlights, a snarling open mouth with two lower tusks, wild dark red hair, bare scarred chest and back, a ragged brown loincloth. BOTH hands grip the long dark wooden shaft of a massive TWO-HANDED MAUL: a heavy squared iron-banded stone head, NOT a gold gauntlet, NOT a bare fist and NOT a hand wearing any glove. Exactly the shipped flat token's crouched pose family, disc and steep overhead camera, but with the raised gold-gauntleted fist replaced by the two-handed maul held across the body, its long shaft diagonal and its heavy head low beside one knee. Enraged, brutal and complete.
prompt_fields.contrast: Four ogres share this body: the MAULER is the BRICK-RED enraged brute wielding a heavy two-handed iron-banded stone maul in BOTH hands (silhouette: crouched wide, maul shaft diagonal with its heavy head low; hue: brick red with dull iron grey; value: mid). The guard is tan with blue trousers, an armoured shoulder and a one-handed hammer; the rune-spinner is orange with runes and fire; the pounder is a blue grappler with arms spread wide. This repaint reverses the superseded token's raised gold gauntlet and missing weapon: the NPC equips a greatmaul (game/modules/tome/data/general/npcs/ogre.lua:95) and the accepted standee holds a big two-handed maul. Keep the maul clearly a two-handed weapon, not a one-handed hammer, so the mauler still reads apart from the ogre-guard.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. The ENTIRE creature, every limb, tail, wing, drip, staff and effect included, fits inside a circle of about three quarters of the disc radius around the disc centre, leaving a wide bare charcoal ring of base plate on every side, yet the creature is large and bold inside that circle. This is a huge giant, but on the tabletop disc it is drawn COMPACT: hunched forward with rolled shoulders, bent knees and elbows kept in close, the weapon held short and close to the body, so the whole figure is a broad chunky mass that fills the inner three quarters of the disc yet never reaches the outer sixth ring band. Do not draw a tall standing figure that would run off the disc; the feet and the head both stay well inside the disc.
prompt_fields.palette: Brick-red skin with lighter orange highlight planes, dark red hair, brown loincloth, small ivory tusks; the maul is a heavy squared stone/iron head with dull grey iron bands on a dark brown wooden shaft. No gold gauntlet and no gold glove anywhere. The rest of the creature keeps the shipped token's brick-red value structure. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
